description: Aviation reference tools for analysts, researchers and product teams. Resolve airports, airlines, aircraft types, registrations and flight identifiers with confidence, historical validity and source provenance. Inspect airport network integration, operator and ownership facts, engagement exceptions, connectivity and passenger-size bands. Explore a catalogue of aviation AI use cases, their data requirements, message lineage and an EASA framework screen. Reference and research data only: not live operational, flight-status, booking or safety-control information. Users can also submit product feedback for human review.

defaultPrompt: Which airline used the designator BA on 1 January 1990, and what does the answer say about reused codes?
What was Berlin Brandenburg's Network Manager integration level in June 2025, and now? Cite the notices.
Show the AI use-case landscape for airport operators, then three use cases for a security manager with their data needs.
